<MethodEndpoint
  method={"get"}
  path={"/api/auth/me/export"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Streams a zip archive of everything you can already see in the app:
every post in your groups (including other members' posts), the
comments and reactions on them, your own favorites, the chat of your
groups that have chat switched on, the profiles (id, name, email,
avatar) of the people you share a group with, and exactly the
uploaded photos/videos all of that references (display copies,
thumbnails and originals, under `uploads/`). JSON lives under
`data/`; `manifest.json` records the export time, server version and
row counts.

Circle-private posts in circles you are not a member of, other
groups' content, other members' favorites and notification
preferences, credentials, invites, tokens and notification history
are never included.

Rate-limited to 5 exports per user per hour.
